'''Wayniss''' was the chief [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Poison Moon (starship)|''Poison Moon'']]. He was an aging ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who knew nothing of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He also did not know that those who had been employing him were [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and would have reacted incuriously if he had. He was known to give good value for his pay and would remain loyal as long as he was paid, making him reliable and dependable in the eyes of [[Dician]].
